We came across a reel on Instagram regarding this place serving good taste pizza along with Amul cheese infused pizzas. Today we got an opportunity to try this place.

Firstly the front of the house employee directly asked us what pizza are we ordering, rather than asking whether it’s our first time etc, nor offered us the menu booklet. These are basic restaurant attics expected by a customer.

Moving forward, we ordered  Amul Tikka pizza, being Amul cheese infused pizzas as the description says and an Amul cheese lover we definitely wanted to try this out.

But I can definitely say it was the worst pizza I ever had.

The crust tasted like a store bought, not a homemade one. Never tasted like Amul cheese infused pizzas. As an Indian, can definitely tell the taste of Amul cheese and Canadian cheese.

Would never go to this place again nor will recommend anyone else.

I usually order the regular bowl with paneer and mango lassi, and I’ve always loved their mango lassi. This was not my first visit, but today I was really disappointed.

The mango lassi didn’t taste like it normally does, so I went all the way back and politely asked to exchange it. The employee did replace it, but instead of acknowledging my concern, he started explaining that they always make it fresh with the same recipe. Another employee joined in as well, and it felt like they were trying to prove me wrong rather than listen to my concern.
